records.question: Does stablecoin liquidity provide incremental information about future 20-day canonical BRRK outcomes beyond the frozen price/regime information already available to BRRK-0011?
records.hypothesis: A prospectively frozen stablecoin-liquidity state contains incremental predictive information about future 20-day canonical BRRK net returns beyond the frozen BRRK price/regime state vector.
records.economic_mechanism: Changes in aggregate USD-pegged stablecoin supply may proxy changes in crypto-native deployable liquidity and risk appetite that are not fully represented by the frozen BRRK price/regime state.
records.stopping_rule: Do not retrieve full historical data or evaluate the model until the exact source/data contract and PIT semantics are frozen. Then run exactly one frozen Stage-1 information-test variant once. Release only the preregistered primary result classification and primary metric first. PASS may create a separately preregistered robustness-stage research ID; FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE stops this research ID with no rescue tuning.
success_criteria: At least 730 valid walk-forward OOS predictions remain after decision-time filtering, training-only normalization and 20-day label purging.
The mean baseline-minus-augmented squared-error loss differential is greater than zero.
A one-sided HAC test with maximum lag 19 rejects H0: mean loss differential <= 0 at alpha=0.05.
No PIT, provenance, data-contract, variant-budget or governance blocking finding occurs.
failure_criteria: FAIL_NO_INCREMENTAL_INFORMATION if the mean primary loss differential is <= 0 after the frozen run.
INCONCLUSIVE if the mean primary loss differential is > 0 but the one-sided HAC criterion is not met, or fewer than 730 valid OOS predictions remain.
Any PIT, provenance, unregistered-variant or data-contract violation invalidates the run rather than becoming a research result.
allowed_followup: Only PASS_INCREMENTAL_INFORMATION may create a new separately preregistered robustness-stage research ID.
A later portfolio-integration experiment requires a separate research ID after robustness and incremental-information admission; no direct integration is allowed from this Stage-1 result.
forbidden_followup: No same-ID feature, horizon, target, estimator, regularization, availability-lag, universe or threshold rescue after any result is observed.
No selection among USDT-only, USDC-only or other stablecoin decompositions based on observed performance.
No direct Edge Registry admission, BRRK modification, portfolio multiplier, leverage, short, Phase-7 activation or production authorization from this experiment.
researcher_decisions: Baseline is the canonical frozen P3.2 BRRK state/target path; do not rebuild a substitute price model.
Augmented model differs from baseline only by STABLECOIN_LIQUIDITY_STATE_V1.

STABLECOIN_LIQUIDITY_STATE_V1 is fixed as aggregate USD-pegged stablecoin supply 20-day log growth plus acceleration defined as current 20-day log growth minus the immediately preceding 20-day log growth.
Primary estimator is Ridge regression with alpha=1.0; no hyperparameter grid is permitted under this research ID.
All normalization is expanding and training-only; full-sample z-scores, winsorization, percentiles or quantiles are forbidden.
At decision timestamp T, only observations with available_at <= T may be used; 20-day labels not fully realized by T are purged from training.

If a historical source row lacks a verifiable publication timestamp, the primary reconstructed-history proxy is available_at = metric_date + 2 days. LAG_1D and LAG_3D are reserved for a separately preregistered robustness stage and cannot replace LAG_2D after observing this result.

If a source later exposes a verifiable historical publication timestamp, exact publication semantics may replace the proxy only if frozen in the data contract before the first result-bearing retrieval/evaluation.
USDT/USDC decomposition may be collected only as a predeclared diagnostic in a later contract and cannot substitute for the aggregate primary feature after seeing results.
records.production_relevance: Research-only Stage-1 external-information test. A PASS is eligible only for the next separately preregistered research stage and cannot change BRRK, phase authority or production authorization.
notes: Formal research path, frozen Data Contract, first-capture provenance and Stage-1 Run Interface now exist prospectively under the registered governed prefix.
Validation dataset STABLECOIN-LIQUIDITY-0001-DEFILLAMA-HIST-V1 is reconstructed RESEARCHER_EXPOSED_HISTORY and was exposed as RAW_DATA before Stage-1; it is not sealed or temporally unseen.

The exact Stage-1 baseline/augmented design, PIT alignment, label, walk-forward purge, normalization, Ridge alpha=1.0, HAC lag=19, release policy and one-shot execution lock are frozen in research/stablecoin_liquidity_0001/RUN_INTERFACE.json before any real Stage-1 model evaluation.
